; PORTS
; locations 365c and 3660 hold port numbers used
;  to talk to the EMUP
; There are only 2 ports!
;  3660 holds 0x2E0 - the write only "ID" port
;  365c holds 0x2E2 - the read/write "DATA" port

; If   3660 gets 0x2E0
; then 365c gets 0x2E2
;

; e0 e1 e2 e3 e4 -- e8 eb
